script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: identity

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

EXT. SUBURBAN STREET - DAY

We open on a quaint suburban neighborhood. The sun is shining. Children playing in the front yards. Birds chirping.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
This is the world of the Johanssons.

INT. JOHANSSON KITCHEN - DAY

MARGARET JOHANSSON (mid 40s) is chopping vegetables at the counter. JAMES JOHANSSON (early teens) enters.

JAMES
Mom, can we talk?

MARGARET (continues chopping)
Sure, what's on your mind?

JAMES
I've been thinking a lot about who I am. I don't feel like I fit in here.

MARGARET (pauses, looks at him)
What do you mean, dear?

JAMES
I mean, I don't feel like I belong in this family. Or this town. Or even this world.

MARGARET (pauses, sets down the knife)
James, we love you no matter what. And this town, this family, they're a part of who you are. But I understand that you might feel lost right now. And that's okay.

JAMES (sighs)
But what if I'm just... broken?

MARGARET (takes his hand)
You're not broken, James. You're just figuring out who you are. And that's a beautiful thing.

INT. JOHANSSON FAMILY ROOM - NIGHT

MARGARET, JAMES, and the rest of the family - LUCY (teenage sister), TOM (father), and LUCY (mother) - sit in a circle.

MARGARET
Family, we all have our struggles. And it's important that we support each other through them.

LUCY (sister)
I know I've been distant lately. I've been dealing with some things. But I'm here for you, James.

TOM
And I'm here for all of you. We're in this together.

LUCY (mother)
We'll always be here for you, James.

JAMES (tears in his eyes)
Thank you.

INT. JOHANSSON LIVING ROOM - DAY

JAMES is alone, looking through old family photos.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
James spent hours poring over the old photographs, searching for clues to his identity.

Suddenly, there's a knock at the door. It's LUCAS, an old friend from childhood.

LUCAS
James! I've been looking for you.

JAMES
Lucas? What are you doing here?

LUCAS
I heard about what you're going through. I wanted to help.

JAMES
How?

LUCAS
By reminding you who you are.

INT. JOHANSSON BACKYARD - DAY

JAMES, LUCAS, and their old dog, MAX, play catch. They laugh and reminisce about old times.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
As the sun began to set, James realized that he didn't need to search for his identity. It was already a part of him.

INT. JOHANSSON KITCHEN - NIGHT

MARGARET and the family gather around the table for dinner.

MARGARET
Family, we've had some challenges lately. But we've also had some beautiful moments.

LUCY (sister)
Like when James found his identity.

JAMES
I couldn't have done it without all of you.

TOM
And we're proud of you, James.

LUCY (mother)
Always and forever.

They all share a loving smile.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
